args.new_string: ## Findings - TASK.md (sphinx issue #7454): `None` return hint unlinked in signature mode. Cause: `_parse_annotation`'s inner `make_xref` (sphinx/domains/python.py:73) hardcoded `reftype='class'`; `None` is `py:data` in the Python inventory, so intersphinx never matched. Description mode worked because `PyField`/`PyTypedField.make_xref` (python.py:264-287) already special-case `None`→`obj` role. - Fix (minimal, mirrors existing special-case): in `_parse_annotation.make_xref`, use `reftype='obj'` when `text == 'None'`, else `'class'`. Only file changed: sphinx/domains/python.py (6+/1-). Not committed, per TASK.md. - Verified with issue reproducer (local objects.inv, `None` as `py:data` like the real inventory): signature mode now emits `None` in `f1`'s signature; description mode output matches the issue's expected HTML exactly; `int` still links. - Env quirks (pre-existing, not from the fix): venv sphinxcontrib 2.x requires Sphinx>=5 vs checkout 3.0.1 → `VersionRequirementError` in builds/tests; worked around out-of-tree (no-op `require_sphinx` via C:/Windows/Temp/patchreq.py pytest plugin + build driver). pytest OOMs from a warnings flood (polluted C:/Users/agent/.runner cache scratch dirs); `-p no:warnings` + `--basetemp` fixes it. `test_autodoc_default_options` fails on the clean tree too.
